name: Can mobility improvement remodeling increase my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Can mobility improvement remodeling increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mobility improvement remodeling can enhance a home's value, particularly in areas with an aging population or for buyers seeking accessible features. While not all modifications offer a direct dollar-for-dollar return, features like zero-threshold showers, wider doorways, and well-integrated ramps can broaden your home's appeal and make it stand out. The value increase also comes from the improved quality of life and safety for the current residents.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, mobility remodeling can increase home value by appealing to a broader market, especially those seeking accessible features or planning for the future.
